description: One fade control blending two pairs of signals at once, in 2HP, for a stereo pair or two separate mono signals

params.text: Sets the blend, all A fully counter-clockwise and all B fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the fade CV between -100% and +100%, and is ignored while the jack is in trigger mode
Jumps the fade knob between full A and full B, and works only while nothing is patched into the fade jack
Chooses how the jack beside it is read: as a voltage that moves the fade, or in red as a trigger that flips between full A and full B

inputs.text: Moves the fade, 5V covering half the knob's travel at full trim, or flips it on each trigger in trigger mode
The A side of that pair; with the lower A jack empty it reads the upper B input
The B side of that pair; with the lower B jack empty it reads the upper A input

outputs.text: Carries that pair blended by the fade

notes: patching only the upper A and the lower B inputs gives two outputs that fade in opposite directions, because of the crossed normalling
patching only one input of a pair turns that section into an attenuator, since the fade runs it against silence
menu: Fade-mode (scaling of fade-knob/input): Logarithmic, Linear, Exponential — bends how the fade moves across the knob's travel
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it
